name: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Limited
summary: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Limited manufactures and sells white oils in India. It offers mineral and specialty oils, petroleum jellies, industrial solvents, and paraffin waxes for consumer, healthcare, chemicals, and plastics sectors; lubricants, including automotive oils and industrial oils for automobile, and industrial machines and equipment; and process and insulating oils comprising transformer oils and rubber processing oils for transformer manufacturers, power generation and distribution, and tyre and rubber product manufacturers.
